title: Align Info timeout redirect with locale and env timeout
completion_summary: Aligned Info redirect target and timeout with locale-aware ASTRO_APP_URL path, safe timeout parsing, and fallback redirect chain.
acceptance_criteria: Info redirect target uses ASTRO_APP_URL-based app path in local dev and preserves locale when applicable.
Optional timeout property is parsed safely; invalid or missing values fall back to current default timeout.
When override is absent, redirect chain still falls back to pageRedirectUri/actionUri/client.baseUrl.
